name: baserow
label: Baserow
description: Open-source online database tool, alternative to Airtable

apiUrl.label: API URL
apiUrl.description: The host of your Baserow instance, such as api.baserow.io for Baserow Cloud.

token.label: Database Token
token.description: Go to Settings > Database tokens in Baserow, create a token, copy it, and paste it here.

baserow_get_row.label: Get Row
baserow_get_row.description: Gets a single row by its ID from a table.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_id.label: Row
row_id.description: Rows are listed by their ID, up to the first 200.

baserow_find_row.label: Find Row
baserow_find_row.description: Finds a row by matching a field value. Returns the first match.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

field_value.label: Field Value
field_value.description: Returns the first row whose value equals this exactly.

baserow_find_row.beforeRequest: const field = /^\d+$/.test(inputs.field_name) ? 'field_' + inputs.field_name : inputs.field_name; request.query['filter__' + field + '__equal'] = inputs.field_value; return request;
baserow_find_row.afterResponse: return response.results.length === 0 ? {found: false, count: 0} : {found: true, count: response.count, ...response.results[0]};

baserow_aggregate_field.label: Aggregate Field
baserow_aggregate_field.description: Calculates a sum, average, count and more over a column in a view.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

view_id.label: View
view_id.description: The grid view to use. Its filters apply to the result.

aggregation_type.label: Calculation
aggregation_type.description: Sum, average, median, deviation and variance need a number column.

baserow_batch_create_rows.label: Batch Create Rows
baserow_batch_create_rows.description: Creates up to 200 rows in one request.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: A JSON list of rows, up to 200, keyed by column name.

baserow_batch_create_rows.beforeRequest: const rows = request.body.items; if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error('Rows must be a JSON array.'); if (rows.length > 200) throw new Error('At most 200 rows per request.'); return request;

baserow_batch_update_rows.label: Batch Update Rows
baserow_batch_update_rows.description: Updates up to 200 rows in one request.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: A JSON list of up to 200 rows, each with its id and the new values.

baserow_batch_update_rows.beforeRequest: const rows = request.body.items; if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error('Rows must be a JSON array.'); if (rows.length > 200) throw new Error('At most 200 rows per request.'); return request;

baserow_upload_file.label: Upload File
baserow_upload_file.description: Uploads a file from a link, ready to put in a file column.

url.label: File URL
url.description: A public link Baserow can download the file from.

baserow_list_rows_ai.label: List Rows
baserow_list_rows_ai.description: Lists rows from a table with optional search, sorting, filters and view.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only return rows with cell data matching this text.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Optional filter tree: {"filter_type": "AND" | "OR", "filters": [{"field": "<field name or ID>", "type": "<operator>", "value": "<value>"}], "groups": [<nested tree>]}. Operators include equal, not_equal, contains, contains_not, higher_than, lower_than, date_is, empty, not_empty, boolean, link_row_has, single_select_equal.

order_by.label: Order By
order_by.description: Comma-separated field names; prefix a name with "-" for descending, e.g. "-Created,Name".

include.label: Include Fields
include.description: Only return these field names. Leave empty for all fields.

exclude.label: Exclude Fields
exclude.description: Field names to leave out of the response.

view_id.label: View
view_id.description: Applies the filters and sorts saved on this view.

baserow_list_rows_ai.beforeRequest: if (inputs.size && (Number(inputs.size) < 1 || Number(inputs.size) > 200)) throw new Error('Page Size must be between 1 and 200.'); request.query.page = inputs.page || '1'; request.query.size = inputs.size || '100'; for (const key of ['include', 'exclude']) { const names = JSON.parse(inputs[key] || '[]'); if (names.length > 0) request.query[key] = names.map(String).join(','); } if (inputs.filters) { const filters = JSON.parse(inputs.filters); if (typeof filters !== 'object' || filters === null || Array.isArray(filters)) throw new Error('Filters must be a JSON object.'); request.query.filters = JSON.stringify(filters); } return request;
baserow_list_rows_ai.afterResponse: return {count: response.count, has_more: response.next !== null, rows: response.results};

baserow_delete_row_ai.label: Delete Row
baserow_delete_row_ai.description: Deletes a row by its ID.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_id.label: Row
row_id.description: Rows are listed by their ID, up to the first 200.

baserow_delete_row_ai.afterResponse: return {deleted: true, table_id: Number(inputs.table_id), row_id: Number(inputs.row_id)};

baserow_batch_delete_rows_ai.label: Batch Delete Rows
baserow_batch_delete_rows_ai.description: Deletes up to 200 rows in one request.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_ids.label: Row IDs
row_ids.description: Numeric IDs of the rows to delete. Maximum 200.

baserow_batch_delete_rows_ai.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.row_ids || '[]'); if (ids.length === 0) throw new Error('Row IDs must contain at least one ID.'); if (ids.length > 200) throw new Error(`Row IDs accepts at most 200 IDs per call; received ${ids.length}.`); const numbers = ids.map((id) => { const value = Number(id); if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) throw new Error(`Row IDs contains an invalid ID: ${String(id)}.`); return value; }); request.body.items = numbers; return request;
baserow_batch_delete_rows_ai.afterResponse: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.row_ids).map(Number); return {deleted: true, count: ids.length, row_ids: ids};

baserow_list_tables.label: List Tables
baserow_list_tables.description: Lists the tables the connection can access.
baserow_list_tables.afterResponse: return {count: response.length, tables: response.map((table) => ({id: table.id, name: table.name, database_id: table.database_id}))};

baserow_get_table_fields.label: Get Table Fields
baserow_get_table_fields.description: Lists the fields (columns) of a table.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

baserow_get_table_fields.afterResponse: return {count: response.length, fields: response.map((field) => ({id: field.id, name: field.name, type: field.type, primary: field.primary, read_only: field.read_only, select_options: 'select_options' in field ? field.select_options.map((option) => ({id: option.id, value: option.value})) : undefined, link_row_table_id: 'link_row_table_id' in field ? field.link_row_table_id : undefined}))};

baserow_list_row_names.label: List Row Names
baserow_list_row_names.description: Gets the primary field value of the given rows.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_ids.label: Row IDs
row_ids.description: Numeric row IDs to look up.

baserow_list_row_names.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.row_ids || '[]'); if (ids.length === 0) throw new Error('Row IDs must contain at least one ID.'); if (ids.length > 200) throw new Error(`Row IDs accepts at most 200 IDs per call; received ${ids.length}.`); const numbers = ids.map((id) => { const value = Number(id); if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value <= 0) throw new Error(`Row IDs contains an invalid ID: ${String(id)}.`); return value; }); request.query['table__' + inputs.table_id] = numbers.join(','); return request;
baserow_list_row_names.afterResponse: const names = response[String(inputs.table_id)] ?? {}; return {rows: Object.entries(names).map(([id, name]) => ({id: Number(id), name}))};

baserow_create_row.label: Create Row
baserow_create_row.description: Creates a new row in a table.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

table_fields.label: Table Fields
table_fields.description: JSON object of field name to value, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}.

create_missing_select_options.label: Create Missing Select Options
create_missing_select_options.description: Adds any select option the column does not have yet. Baserow allows this only for an Email & Password sign-in, so a Database Token leaves the options as they are.

baserow_update_row.label: Update Row
baserow_update_row.description: Changes fields in an existing row.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_id.label: Row
row_id.description: Rows are listed by their ID, up to the first 200.

table_fields.label: Table Fields
table_fields.description: JSON object of field name to value, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}.

create_missing_select_options.label: Create Missing Select Options
create_missing_select_options.description: Adds any select option the column does not have yet. Baserow allows this only for an Email & Password sign-in, so a Database Token leaves the options as they are.

baserow_clean_row.label: Clean Row
baserow_clean_row.description: Clears the fields of a row that you leave empty.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

row_id.label: Row
row_id.description: Rows are listed by their ID, up to the first 200.

table_fields.label: Table Fields
table_fields.description: JSON object of field name to value, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}.

baserow_upsert_row.label: Upsert Row
baserow_upsert_row.description: Creates a new row or updates an existing one by matching a field value.

table_id.label: Table
table_id.description: Only tables this connection can access are listed.

match_field.label: Match Field
match_field.description: The column that identifies the row, such as an email.

match_value.label: Match Value
match_value.description: The exact value to look for in the match field.

table_fields.label: Table Fields
table_fields.description: JSON object of field name to value, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}.

create_missing_select_options.description: Adds any select option the column does not have yet. Baserow allows this only for an Email & Password sign-in, so a Database Token leaves the options as they are.

baserow_row_created.label: New Row
baserow_row_created.description: Triggers when a new row is created in a Baserow table. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows created.

baserow_row_updated.label: Updated Row
baserow_row_updated.description: Triggers when an existing row is updated in a Baserow table, with its new and previous values. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows updated.
baserow_row_updated.afterResponse: return (response.items ?? []).map((row, index) => ({row, previous: (response.old_items ?? [])[index] ?? null})).filter(({row, previous}) => !previous || JSON.stringify(row) !== JSON.stringify(previous));

baserow_row_deleted.label: Deleted Row
baserow_row_deleted.description: Triggers when a row is deleted from a Baserow table, with its ID. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows deleted.

baserow_row_event.label: Any Row Change
baserow_row_event.description: Triggers when a row is created, updated or deleted in a table, with the kind of change. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the events Rows created, Rows updated and Rows deleted.

baserow_rows_created.label: New Rows (Batch)
baserow_rows_created.description: Triggers once with all the rows created together, as one list. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows created.
baserow_rows_created.afterResponse: const rows = response.items ?? []; return [{rows, count: rows.length}];

baserow_rows_updated.label: Updated Rows (Batch)
baserow_rows_updated.description: Triggers once with all the rows updated together, as one list, each with its new and previous values. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows updated.
baserow_rows_updated.afterResponse: const rows = (response.items ?? []).map((row, index) => ({row, previous: (response.old_items ?? [])[index] ?? null})); return [{rows, count: rows.length}];

baserow_rows_deleted.label: Deleted Rows (Batch)
baserow_rows_deleted.description: Triggers once with the IDs of all the rows deleted together. In Baserow, open the ··· menu beside the table, choose Webhooks > Create webhook, set the method to POST, paste the trigger's address and select the event Rows deleted.
